text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I wander along the
riverbank...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heh, Opera O. Are you here to watch
the sunset
too?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Not quite. I've come here... to make an
oath.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...An oath?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Indeed. To the setting sun himself.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
He must be ill at ease. For to
think—what should
become of this world
without his glorious light?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I thought it only fitting that I be the one
to
console him—and give my word as the
rising
Centurial Overlord.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, Sun. You may rest in peace. I vow
to
illuminate the world in your stead.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: (What the heck?!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
(What's with the "Overlord" title?!
There's no way
she can make a promise
with the sun! This is all so
freakin'...)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: (So freakin' coooool!)

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, uh... Actually, now you mention it... I
was
thinkin' of making an oath to the sun
too.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well now. Could you promise anything
grander
than enshrining the operatic
conquest of the
undefeated Overlord?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: En...shrining? Uh, t-totally! 'Course I can!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
My oath is to become the star of any
distance! To
win more G1s than anyone
ever, and show the
world what I'm made
of!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make my legacy shine brighter
than all
others! And then I'll make a
ginormous statue of
myself!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I swear I'll make a name for myself. A
name that
shines brighter than the sun
itself!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Excellent!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Vodka, your ambition is indisputably...
cool! I
daresay your coolness could even
rival my
elegance!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. ♪ Well, I mean, uh... that's just
me,
y'know?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Say, do you have some spare time? Let
us share
all of our vows with the sun.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Opera O, it'd be my honor!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The pair run off down the riverbank,
chasing the
sun's last glimmer over the
horizon.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Uh, what is up with those two?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I came here to do some solo training,
but now I
can't concentrate at all!
